description: Defines the reusable stat, resource, buff/debuff, and one-shot effects granted by cursed tools, cursed objects, and extras, including their numeric parameters and the text shown in item descriptions.

Id.technical: FName key resolved from FGameDataTableRow_EquipmentItem::Id_EquipmentItemEffect. EquipmentItemDataTables points here through EquipmentItemEffectDataTables; helpers scan tables in order and append the first row with the requested name. A None effect ID is skipped by callers.

EffectType.simple: Selects which gameplay effect this row applies.
EffectType.technical: EGameEquipmentItemEffectType (None=0 through StepDistance=78, Invalid=255). GameEquipment_GetEffectRowsOfType filters effect rows by exact type; status queries then add, multiply, threshold, or randomly apply EffectValue depending on that type. Examples: HitPointMax/HitPointMaxAlly/Enemy feed PvE HP calculations; SendAttackDamage and SendAttackDamageWithHitPointRate feed the damage-rate query; one-shot types are enumerated at the HP-change path and route the row's buff ID to self, ally, or rival lists. Default None.

EffectValue.simple: Numeric parameters for the effect; behavior depends on EffectType and array index.
EffectValue.technical: TArray<float> at row offset 0x18; exported rows contain three floats and often use [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Index 0 is the additive/stat value for plain effects (for example HitPointMax) and a multiplier/rate for *Rate effects, where 1.0 is neutral and SumEffectRate adds Value-1.0. For probability-driven effects index 0 is a 0..1 chance passed as Value*100 out of 100, and index 1 is the applied magnitude; for at-value effects index 0 is the HP/ratio threshold and index 1 is the added rate or value. HitPointWhenJustGuard uses index 0 as chance and index 1 as flat HP. Index 2 is serialized but no identified consumer reads it. Missing indices are read unguarded by several helpers.

Id_BuffDebuff.simple: Buff/debuff row applied by this effect, if any.
Id_BuffDebuff.technical: FName at row offset 0x28; None means no direct buff. CollectAttackBuffDebuffIds and the once-effect path add this ID to self/ally/rival buff lists according to EffectType (for example HitPointWithTimeOnceAlly -> ally list, *Enemy -> rival list). Item description resolves the named BuffDebuff row; if its enum is not 0x1D, the buff's first FloatValue replaces EffectValue[0] as the displayed VALUE parameter. Exported rows use this mainly for timed/recovery and one-shot effects.

Id_BattleText.simple: Localized description text ID for this effect.
Id_BattleText.technical: FName at row offset 0x30. GameItem_GetDescriptionText requests this ID with a VALUE text parameter derived from EffectValue[0] (or the linked BuffDebuff's FloatValue[0] when applicable). Extras use a separate fixed key BTL_ITEM_BUFF_MESSAGE_1000 with EffectValue[0] instead of this field.

notes: The export contains 268 rows and 72 distinct EffectType values. The full enum and all consumers were considered; the semantics above are grouped by how the source reads the fields, because each effect type supplies its own meaning to the same numeric array.
Chance rolls use stream 2 with EffectValue[0] * 100 out of 100. Rate helpers treat 1.0 as neutral by subtracting one, so exported values like 0.4 or 1.1 are not uniformly a percentage.
One-use effects are also tracked by BattleManager item-use counts; the effect's index in EquipmentItemDataTable::Id_EquipmentItemEffect is part of that state.
Multiple EquipmentItemEffectDataTable shards may exist; helpers append the first match per ID from each array. Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available.

usages.detail: Resolves all effects named by the equipped Item's VariableId-linked EquipmentItem row.
Filters resolved effect rows by EGameEquipmentItemEffectType for every stat query.
Sums or maximizes EffectValue[0] for additive effect types.
Aggregates multiplier-style effects by subtracting 1.0 from EffectValue[0].
Rolls EffectValue[0] as a chance before granting an effect's Id_BuffDebuff.
Applies one-shot effect types on HP change and routes Id_BuffDebuff to self/ally/rival.
Applies HitPointMax, HitPointMaxAlly, and HitPointMaxEnemy effects to PvE character hit point calculations.
Builds the two item-description lines from EffectValue and Effect->Id_BattleText.
